project.name: Apex Media Agency Website
project.brief: Build a professional website for a video production agency with a homepage, portfolio, service pages, lead capture form, responsive design and basic SEO.

proposal.explanation: Supersedes the original unvalidated 90000-cent / 30-hour smoke-test baseline for the same proposed six-page scope. Actual independent specialist analysis estimates 47 hours (41–58-hour range) at an unverified blended internal cost of 2500 cents/hour: 117500-cent base plus 23500-cent contingency (20%) = 141000 cents. This leaves only 9000 cents projected gross margin. Recommend deferring delivery approval until scope and financial assumptions are validated, then reducing scope or renegotiating price. This is a provisional cost baseline, not a commercially endorsed fixed-price offer.

statementOfWork.objective: Present Apex Media's production work and services clearly and enable prospective clients to submit enquiries.
scope: Proposed six-page marketing website using reusable templates.
Portfolio with up to six externally hosted video embeds.
Lead form with name, email and enquiry fields, validation, spam protection and delivery to one client-approved inbox.
Responsive layouts and basic on-page and technical SEO.

Basic SEO includes page titles/descriptions, headings, meaningful image alt text, canonical domain, sitemap and robots/indexing configuration; no migration, keyword campaign, schema expansion, analytics or ranking guarantee.

acceptanceCriteria: Client confirms page counts, content ownership and enquiry destination.

acceptanceCriteria: Client approves layouts, navigation, typography and call-to-action placement.

deliverables.name: Implemented website
deliverables.description: Six proposed pages, six video embeds, working enquiry form and SEO setup.
deliverables.expectedOutcome: Visitors can review work and submit enquiries.
acceptanceCriteria: All agreed pages and videos work.
A valid test enquiry reaches the approved inbox; invalid input is rejected.
Pages have unique titles and descriptions, appropriate headings, image alt text, sitemap and robots configuration.
dependencies: Approved design, final content and client-provided hosting access through an approved secure method.

deliverables.name: QA and handover
deliverables.description: Test results, deployment and ownership instructions.
deliverables.expectedOutcome: Reviewed website ready for client acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: Acceptance checks pass and no critical defects remain.
Client receives deployment and service ownership instructions.
dependencies: Completed build and client acceptance review.

exclusions: Video production or editing, copywriting, branding and media licensing.
Custom CMS, ecommerce, accounts, CRM integration and multilingual content.
Ongoing maintenance, subscriptions, additional pages or revisions.
Search ranking guarantees and ongoing SEO campaigns.

Formal accessibility certification/audit, guaranteed performance scores, uptime SLA, analytics/consent platform implementation and migration/redirect mapping unless separately scoped. Baseline usability, keyboard/form checks and embed privacy review remain included.
acceptanceCriteria: Approved scope and content are present.
No horizontal overflow at 375, 768 and 1440 CSS-pixel widths.
Navigation, video playback and form delivery pass on current Chrome, Safari and Firefox at acceptance.
Form labels, keyboard navigation, visible focus and error messages pass manual checks.
HTTPS is enabled; no server secrets are exposed in browser assets; form input is validated server-side or by the selected form provider.
Client reviews the agreed checklist; unresolved defects are recorded before acceptance.
Every agreed page is reachable; internal links have no broken targets; canonical domain and production indexing match approved instructions.
Approved portfolio embeds play on the agreed test matrix or show an informative fallback when the external host is unavailable.
Client approves browser/version matrix before build; testing covers Chrome and Firefox desktop and Safari desktop/mobile at 375, 768 and 1440 CSS-pixel layout widths where applicable.
No critical or high-severity defects remain; lower-severity items require written client acceptance or an agreed correction plan.

commercialTerms: Agreed client revenue:150000 USD cents. Receipt, tax treatment, payment due dates and collectability unverified.
Proposed payment schedule for negotiation:75000 cents on accepted SOW and75000 cents on final acceptance; neither milestone is confirmed or received.

Client-funded domain, hosting, form and video subscriptions require named billing owners and confirmed costs; these costs are excluded from the agency delivery budget only if client agrees to pay directly.

Draft acceptance process: named client decision-maker reviews against the checklist within two business days per milestone; silence does not imply acceptance. Review and correction terms require agreement.

This SOW is a draft for scope/commercial review, not an accepted contract or authorization to start. Agency recommends resolving scope and financial viability before offering a binding delivery commitment.

statementOfWork.changeManagement: Record requested changes, assess effort, third-party costs, schedule and acceptance impact, then obtain client agreement and separate authorized owner financial review before implementation. Extra features, pages, revisions or changed integration requirements are changes.
